name: Naphtha vapor cooled to its dew point (plug-in)
description: Needs the example plug-in (examples/plugin): the dew-point cooler unit and the light-naphtha-cut pseudo-component come from it. A hydrocarbon vapor at 250 °C is cooled to 5 K above its dew point at 2.5 bar. The cooler prices its own exchanger (costing), and its dynamic model, also from the plug-in, answers a step of the superheat to 15 K with a 40 s lag.
